status: living paper snapshot; 124M horizon is complete through 900 steps, 2700 is pending, the Muon side of a seven-seed replication is measured, and clean 355M scaling is pending
principle: Only measured values belong here. Historical or superseded experiments remain in artifacts/measured.json. Incomplete or provenance-mismatched runs are kept explicit and never promoted to headline evidence.
noise_floor_note: Cross-session movement is configuration-dependent; treat sub-0.005 gaps cautiously unless a same-configuration reproduction is available.

shared_config_124m_900.source: astro_lab shared configuration snapshot, Tesla T4, GPT-2 124M, FineWeb-Edu, 900 steps
shared_config_124m_900.interpretation: At this shared configuration ASTRO-v2 and ASTRO-Muon-Betas are effectively tied and both are substantially below Muon; AdaMuon is effectively tied with Muon and NorMuon is worse. This is a pointwise result, not a universal ranking.

targeted_mechanism_124m_900.source: astro_lab targeted mechanism run, Tesla T4, seed 0, three shared configurations
targeted_mechanism_124m_900.interpretation: Most of the measured ASTRO-v2 advantage survives removal of variance_power/gamma and is already present in ASTRO-Muon-Betas. The aggressive-LR configuration produces the largest gap, making robustness a leading hypothesis. Three configurations are directional evidence only; they are not independent seeds.

end_to_end_124m_300.source: colab_bench.py expanded tuning, GPT-2 124M, FineWeb-Edu, 300 steps, three evaluation seeds
end_to_end_124m_300.interpretation: The earlier/plain ASTRO recipe does not beat Muon in this tuned 300-step benchmark. This is important negative evidence and should not be conflated with ASTRO-v2's 900-step shared-configuration results.

horizon_124m_v2.source: astro_lab horizon run, Tesla T4, source fingerprint 7b321ff7fda3; five shared configurations per horizon
horizon_124m_v2.interpretation: The 300, 600, and 900 cells are complete. Mean paired margins are negative at all three horizons, with the 900-step mean widening to about -0.0816 across five shared configurations. The effect is not uniform: ASTRO-v2 wins three of five 900-step settings. The 2700 cell remains entirely unmeasured because the interrupted first Muon run did not finish validation and was not saved.

replication_124m_900.source: astro_lab fixed-configuration replication, Tesla T4, source fingerprint 7b321ff7fda3
replication_124m_900.interpretation: Seven Muon seeds are measured and tightly clustered. ASTRO-v2 seeds 100-106 are still pending, so no paired replication claim is made yet.

discarded_partial_355m.note: partial run used a different astro_lab fingerprint from the 124M evidence and is retained only as a research log

mechanistic_qkv.source: colab_probe.py pretrained and random-init checkpoint probes
mechanistic_qkv.important_control: Random initialization also exhibits V skew, so the paper must not claim that training creates the entire effect. The defensible claim is that fused treatment produces allocation imbalance and splitting restores substantially more balanced Q/K/V allocation.
